name: LidaRF Hybrid Representation
definition: A NeRF variant for street scenes that fuses explicit Lidar point cloud features with an implicit hash-based grid representation to improve geometry and rendering quality under sparse and collinear camera trajectories.
summary: LidaRF Hybrid Representation fuses explicit LiDAR point cloud features with an implicit hash-based grid to improve geometry and rendering quality in street scenes under sparse camera trajectories.
